title: Workspace Scope label (no vendor names in UI)
description:
Folder system and right-click menus now say Workspace Scope instead of Wasabi scope. User-facing copy across PipeShare, PipeSync, cPanel, and marketing no longer names internal cloud vendors.

Who is affected: BASE after deploy; SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Rename Wasabi scope → Workspace Scope in Folder system UI.
Remove vendor service names from user-facing toasts, errors, and site copy.
